mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and overcast at Verona City Hall under a Third Quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.
City news today includes new guidelines for erosion control permits for developers and the announcement of Deputy Chief Liz Gay joining our EMS team.
There is plenty to do with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga sessions scheduled for tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from October 25, officers arrested a man for O W I after he was discovered passed out at an intersection.
Today's flavor is the delicious Turtle Cheesecake, and since the shop is currently open but closing in under an hour, be sure to head over soon to satisfy your craving.
